notes: Every ground and air unit bound for an AO in Iraq now lands at Camp Doha first and then moves north into its sector. Brigades too

New Aerial Refueling Squadron (KC-135 / KC-10): fighters, A-10s and gunships at the same air base reach about 650 km farther (800 with two squadrons). It needs a land air base with a paved runway, not a carrier, and is what lets jets at Al Udeid reach Iraq

More room at the big air bases: Al Udeid 16 slots, Diego Garcia 8, Camp Doha 60, and host-nation bases 12 to 16, expandable to 28. Prince Sultan, Muwaffaq Salti and Incirlik now sit at their real locations
